verdicts.rationale: The neutralizer is the separate I/O communicator: collection uses xmpi_ocomm (spaceparams.F90:974-976), whose rank 0 is excluded from the compute communicator and whose non-root rank ra maps to compute rank ra-1 (xmpi.F90:236-247,288-304). Decomposition entry compute_rank+1 therefore equals ra (spaceparams.F90:578-580), so collection entries ra and i-1 are correct; distribution uses the compute communicator (templates/space_distribute.mako:4-5), making its rank+1 indexing consistent rather than conflicting.
